# Keepsake for iCloud

> Keeps your folders safe in iCloud Drive. A one-way mirror from folders you choose into iCloud Drive/Keepsake/<job>, with a built-in web page and REST API. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple Inc.; iCloud is a trademark of Apple Inc.

Tested environments: unit, API and UI tests on macOS with Python 3.13; the container image built and exercised on Docker Desktop for Mac against fixture folders. Not tested against a real iCloud Drive account.

## Install
- macOS plus Docker Desktop: copy .env.example to .env, set KEEPSAKE_PASSWORD and the two host paths, run `docker compose up -d --build`, open http://localhost:8765.
- Native on macOS: Python 3.11+, no dependencies; `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m keepsake`.

## Key facts
- iCloud Drive exists as a folder only on macOS; Linux and Windows are not supported.
- Originals are only read. Default mode keeps replaced and deleted files under .deleted for 30 days.
- Refuses to run when the source looks empty or shrank, the iCloud folder is not confirmed, or a destination folder is not its own.
- Preview next sync reports what a sync would do, strictly read-only. Pause everything and quiet hours stop scheduled syncs and checks, never a running sync.
- Binds to 127.0.0.1; refuses to start on any other address without a password.
